svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The five rules of Capability Slice Architecture
svg.desc: 1. Slice by scenario: A capability owns a user scenario: a like, a search, a timer. Never a layout block. 2. The host assembles, it doesn’t think: The UI entry point collects slices, sends intents, and performs effects. It holds no product conditions. 3. The runtime is the only bus: A capability never imports another one or reads its slice. They talk through facts. 4. Side effects live at the edge: The logic describes navigation, snackbars, and analytics as effects, and the host performs them. The router and the snackbar themselves never get into the logic. 5. Keep the decider small: About 150 lines or 12 facts. Past that, split the capability.
